description: The plot illustrates the search space of M-Cube under different configurations by comparing the number of possible solutions with the number of missing pieces. The x-axis, labeled "# Missing pieces", has a linear scale, ranges from 1 to 6, and has tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis, labeled "# Possible solutions", is on a logarithmic scale, spans from 10^2 to 10^8, and has tick labels at every power of 10. Two lines are shown: the orange line, labeled "Flip needed", has a solid style and circle markers, starts at approximately 10^2 when the number of missing pieces is 1, and increases to around 10^8 when the number of missing pieces is 6; the blue line, labeled "Flip ignored", also has a solid style and circle markers, begins at roughly 10^1 when the number of missing pieces is 1, and rises to about 10^6 when the number of missing pieces is 6. Both lines exhibit a consistent upward trend as the number of missing pieces increases.
